documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Intimation To The Holders Of Physical Shares To Furnish KYC Details

analysis.summary: Ador Welding Ltd reported a 23% YoY growth in Q1 revenue to Rs. 309 Cr, driven by strong momentum from FY26 and healthy order inflows in domestic and export markets. Management expects operating margins to remain stable, supported by cost discipline, higher capacity utilization, and an improved product mix. The company is executing an ongoing Rs. 80 crore modernization and expansion capex program funded entirely through cash generation without taking on extra leverage over the next couple of years.

guidance.claim: Management expects operating margins to remain at similar levels due to product mix improvements, cost discipline, and higher capacity utilization.
guidance.quote: Operating margins are expected to remain at similar levels, supported by an improving product mix, cost discipline, and higher capacity utilization.

guidance.claim: Distributor expansion in the Middle East is expected to drive further export growth.
guidance.quote: The Middle East remains the primary export market, with continued distributor expansion expected to support further growth.

guidance.claim: The company expects process equipment flare revenue to be around INR 20 crores.
guidance.quote: Yes, I think we should be all right for the process equipment flare from approximately a INR20 crores kind of number that I am talking to you about.

demand_outlook.claim: Q1 FY27 revenue grew 23% YoY to Rs. 309 Cr reflecting healthy order inflows and domestic and export market momentum.
demand_outlook.quote: FY27 has begun strongly for Ador, with Q1 revenue growing 23% YoY to Rs. 309 Cr - reflecting healthy order inflow and strong momentum from FY26 across domestic and export markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising labor costs are driving demand for productivity and efficiency through automation.
demand_outlook.quote: Automation remains a strategic priority as rising labour costs increase demand for productivity and efficiency.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is observing green shoots in shipbuilding, structural, wind, and automotive sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: So I think in terms of industry, first, I think there are a few industries that -- I mean, you guys will know better than me -- but we are seeing green shoots obviously, shipbuilding, a little bit on some structural, wind, like I said, even though it is not a big thing for us at the moment but we are seeing a lot of activity there to get us approved and stuff like that.

demand_outlook.claim: Order book, inquiry base, and approvals suggest exports should perform better in the operating markets.
demand_outlook.quote: So far this year, what we have seen is the order book, inquiry base, and approvals where we are set up, exports should do better -- should do well, should do better for the markets we operate in.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is building internal capabilities in robotics and automation while evaluating acquisition opportunities in the segment.
capex_expansion.quote: Ador continues to build internal capabilities in robotics and automation while evaluating acquisition opportunities to strengthen expertise and accelerate growth in this segment.

capex_expansion.claim: Ador Welding generally spends around INR 30 crores to INR 35 crores in capex for the coming year.
capex_expansion.quote: Our capex is generally in the region of approximately INR30 crores-INR35 crores for the coming year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incurs maintenance capex of approximately INR 10 crores to INR 12 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, so we have generally a maintenance capex and it will come anywhere in the region of INR10 crores-INR12 crores type scenario.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for new lines in welding consumables could reach up to INR 40 crores at most per year over the next two years.
capex_expansion.quote: So we expect INR30 crores- INR35 crores, even it could stretch it out to INR40 maybe at the most over the next two years, each year.

margins_costs.claim: Operating margins are projected to stay at similar levels supported by cost discipline, capacity utilization, and an improved product mix.
margins_costs.quote: Operating margins are expected to remain at similar levels, supported by an improving product mix, cost discipline, and higher capacity utilization.

margins_costs.claim: The company is focusing on higher-margin segments supported by manufacturing upgrades.
margins_costs.quote: Increasing focus on higher-margin segments supported by manufacturing upgrades.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 EBITDA reached approximately INR 38 crores, up 200 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue growth was approximately 3% for the year -- for Quarter 4, sorry and EBITDA clocked in at approximately INR38 crores, an increase of 200 bps.

margins_costs.claim: Full-year standalone revenue grew about 2%, gross margins were 38% (up 250 bps), and EBITDA margin stood at 12%.
margins_costs.quote: For the year standalone, revenue is up about 2%, gross margins at 38%, up about 250 bps. The EBITDA margin at 12%.

margins_costs.claim: Management sees scope for improving margins by another 100 to 200 basis points over coming periods.
margins_costs.quote: So I think on a similar trajectory, you can see that happen, for another 100, 200 basis points going forward over the coming periods.

margins_costs.claim: The company's Q4 FY26 financial figures for EBITDA exclude onerous costs, LD charges, recovery from the Kuwait project, and exceptional items.
margins_costs.quote: *Excluding onerous cost & LD charges, excluding recovery from Kuwait project and exceptional items.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone FY26 EBITDA margin and PBT exclude onerous costs, LD charges, Kuwait project recovery, and exceptional items.
margins_costs.quote: *Excluding onerous cost, LD charges, Kuwait project recovery and exceptional items

orders_capacity.claim: Healthy order inflow from domestic and export markets supported 23% YoY revenue growth in Q1.
orders_capacity.quote: FY27 has begun strongly for Ador, with Q1 revenue growing 23% YoY to Rs. 309 Cr - reflecting healthy order inflow and strong momentum from FY26 across domestic and export markets.

orders_capacity.claim: Ador has an annual installed capacity of 90,000 MT for consumables and 30,000 units for welding power sources.
Welding operations are running at an estimated capacity utilization of approximately 70%.
orders_capacity.quote: We are anywhere -- welding has a lot of different types of lines in consumables as well as in equipment, but I would say a fair estimate is anywhere in the region of approximately 70%.

orders_capacity.claim: Certain manufacturing lines are operating at 90% to 95% utilization, requiring capex and technology investments.
orders_capacity.quote: There are some lines that currently operate at 90%-95% for which we need to undertake capex, some new technologies we need to invest for as well, but yes, pretty much along that.

orders_capacity.claim: The company is experiencing its highest-ever order book in welding automation.
orders_capacity.quote: Seeing that benefit coming, we are seeing our best order book for us on the welding automation than we have ever seen.

orders_capacity.claim: Ador Welding operates 5 manufacturing facilities covering 1.2 million sq. ft.

capital_allocation.claim: Ador recovered INR 14 crores from an old Kuwait project pending from 2020-2021.
capital_allocation.quote: The Kuwait project recovery, which was a lot of good work done by the team for the recovery that was pending from 2020-2021, that finally led to INR14 crores of recovery, and PBT of approximately INR130 crores excluding the onerous cost of the Uran project.

capital_allocation.claim: Return on capital employed stands at approximately 12% on operational EBITDA and 23% overall.
capital_allocation.quote: Return on capital employed is approximately on the operational EBITDA at approximately 12%, and return on capital employed is approximately 23%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Rising labour costs are creating headwinds that increase the need for efficiency and productivity.
risks_headwinds.quote: Automation remains a strategic priority as rising labour costs increase demand for productivity and efficiency.

risks_headwinds.claim: Dispatches were very slow in the first three to four weeks of the March quarter before recovering later.
risks_headwinds.quote: During March quarter, there was a little bit of a dispatch effect, of course, during the first three- four weeks. Towards the end, last few days, we saw traction happen, but yes, what was planned to happen between the 1st and the 20th or 25th of the month was obviously naturally very, very slow.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company has filed an appeal against a INR 14 crore income tax demand.
risks_headwinds.quote: So income tax matter, we have filed our appeal last week only and we don't see any merit, means that the department will succeed in that.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company flagged onerous costs and LD charges in its financial results adjustments.
risks_headwinds.quote: *Excluding onerous cost & LD charges, excluding recovery from Kuwait project and exceptional items.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects capex to be INR 30 crores to INR 35 crores, up to INR 40 crores at most each year over the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: So we expect INR30 crores- INR35 crores, even it could stretch it out to INR40 maybe at the most over the next two years, each year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
